card.name: Inside glaucoma drug and eye-pressure terms
card.fires_on: Partway through glaucoma-related words, such as the end of ROCKLATAN, the 'an' in latanoprost, 'au' in antiglaucoma, and 'owering' or 'ensive' in IOP-lowering or ocular hypotensive agents.
